+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "query, currencies",
+    [
+        pytest.param("", ["EUR", "EUR", "JPY"], id="no_filter"),
+        pytest.param("?currency=EUR", ["EUR", "EUR"], id="EUR"),
+        pytest.param("?currency=JPY", ["JPY"], id="JPY"),
+        pytest.param("?currency=eur", ["EUR", "EUR"], id="lower_case_eur"),
+        pytest.param("?currency=BHD", [], id="BHD"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_account_list_by_currency(bank, query, currencies):
+    conn = ledger.open_db(bank["path"])
+    customer = ledger.create_customer(conn, "Currency Test")
+    for code in ("EUR", "JPY", "EUR"):
+        ledger.open_account(conn, customer, code)
+    conn.close()
+    client = login(bank["app"], customer)
+    response = client.get("/api/accounts" + query)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert sorted(a["currency"] for a in response.json()) == currencies
+
+
